args.title: Tamarack Components: Retail Returns Logistics — Summary
args.body:
Summary of Tamarack Components' latest newsletter, its linked article (blog.tamarack.example/2026/returns), and the companion piece (insights.tamarack.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates have reached 24%, per Tamarack's retail returns logistics article.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
- Companion piece: reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
